Exposure is the famous Riley Ranch locality. This exposure is 3 mi SE of Jacksboro. The locality is .5 mi N and just E of the Curtis Ranch Headquarters. To get to the locality go approxiately 3 mi southeast of Jacksboro on Highway 281 then turn due E on the Highway 380 to Lake Bridgeport. The turnoff for the Curtis Ranch is approxiately 2.9 km, 1.7 mi, from the intersection of 281. Turn N on road to the Curtis Ranch then continue north 1 km, .5 mi, past the ranch house, then continue on foot .5 km, .5 mi, due east to the locality. This locality is a set of ravines on a north facing hillside located approximately 5 km SE of Jacksboro, Texas. To reach the exposures go approximately 2.9 km S of on US Highway 281 and 4 km east of Jacksboro on US Highway 180. Turn N at a cluster of houses, one of which used to be the Riley Ranch Headquaters, and travel NNW for 1 km on a dirt road past the old ranch house. Then walk approximately 1 km E to the edge of limestone bluff at the old trash sump. The ravines are accessible around the dump area below the limestone escarpment. See Boardman et al. 1994 p. 95
